Option B: At Signing & At Closing

Agreement Segment 1: Section 5.4 Conditions to Closing. The Seller’s representations and warranties set forth in Article IV shall be accurate and complete as of the Closing Date. No reference is made to the accuracy of these representations at any prior date except as noted in Section 3.1, which only applies to material facts disclosed in the agreement.

Agreement Segment 2: Section 8.1 Conditions to Obligations of the Buyer. Notwithstanding Section 5.4, all other representations and warranties of the Seller, including those provisioned in Article V not subject to the materiality threshold, shall be deemed accurate both when initially rendered at the Execution Date and maintained continuously until the Closing Date, as if reissued at each point in time.

Agreement Segment 3: Section 9.3 Supplemental Representations. The representations and warranties that are not made as of a specific historical date must be valid at and as of the Expiration Time of the Offer, which is defined for the purposes of the Offer clauses and not intended to affect Closing conditions.
